verdict.rationale: Netlify ships an official, documented CLI (netlify-cli). It is installable via npm and can deploy, run local dev servers, and manage projects from the terminal. Its anonymous deploy flag (`--allow-anonymous`, no login required) suits agent-driven workflows. missing for 10: documented agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive auth for agents), and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI-native workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Deploy sites, run local dev servers, and manage your Netlify projects right from the terminal with this powerful command-line tool.
Deploy directly from your working directory. No login required to start.
